title: Customers & Sales
subtitle: Follow every opportunity from the first conversation to the closed deal.

hero.headline: Stronger relationships. Closer deals.
hero.supporting: From first contact to closing the deal — every detail in one place.

command.aiOff: AI isn't set up — questions that need AI are unavailable; filters and the sales cycle still work.

cycle.title: NOVA sales cycle
cycle.description: Analysis of your open customers. Nothing was sent — follow-up tasks were created where a next step was missing.
cycle.note: Messages are only drafted when you ask, and each one follows your approval rules.

signals.followup_overdue: A follow-up is {days, plural, =0 {due today} one {# day overdue} other {# days overdue}}.
signals.unanswered_question: The customer wrote {days, plural, =0 {today} one {# day ago} other {# days ago}} and hasn't had a reply.
signals.proposal_no_response: The quote was sent {days, plural, one {# day ago} other {# days ago}} and no reply has been recorded.
signals.hot_no_next_step: Hot customer with no next step planned.
signals.stalled: The deal hasn't moved for {days} days.

drawer.noNextAction: No next step yet — schedule a follow-up.

pipeline.title: Pipeline — stage board
pipeline.description: Drag a card to another stage to update it for real.

inbox.title: Conversation inbox
inbox.emptyBody: Your customers' latest messages and reply status will appear here once conversations are recorded.

quotes.title: Quotes
quotes.description: Quotes live in their own record. Pricing, discounts and special terms go to the Approval Center before they can be sent.
quotes.emptyBody: Create a quote from a customer (open the customer → Quote).
quotes.newDescription: Line items, discount and terms. It isn't an invoice.
quotes.approvalNote: Discounts and special terms need approval in the Approval Center before this quote can be sent.

addCustomer.title: Add customer
addCustomer.description: The essentials now — details can come later.
addCustomer.name: Name
addCustomer.moreOptions: More options (value, source, owner, tags, notes)
addCustomer.notesHint: Saved as their first message so the Sales Agent can use it.
addCustomer.aiQualifies: The Sales Agent will qualify this customer in the background.
addCustomer.aiOff: AI isn't set up — the customer is saved and you can work manually.

b2b.title: New B2B opportunity
b2b.description: Company, contact, need, value and next step in one card.
b2b.valueNote: An unknown value stays unknown — it is never counted as 0 in your pipeline.
b2b.aiOff: AI isn't set up — you can still save the opportunity manually.
b2b.assistNote: NOVA uses only what you entered — it doesn't invent budgets, dates or facts.
b2b.emptyBody: Track the company, the need, the value and the next step in one card.

import.title: Import customers
import.description: Upload a CSV → map columns → review duplicates → import. Nothing is imported before you confirm.
import.hint: Up to {max} rows. The first row must be the column names.
import.tooMany: Too many rows — up to {max} per import.
import.mappingHelp: {file}: {count} rows. Match each column to a field.
import.dupNote: Duplicates and invalid rows are skipped — existing customers are never overwritten.

start.title: Start your Sales Desk
start.body: Four steps and NOVA starts following up with every customer.

lead.title: Add your first customer
lead.body: By hand, from your website form, or by importing a CSV.

channel.title: Connect a channel
channel.body: Email, WhatsApp or LinkedIn — reply to customers from NOVA.

opportunity.title: Create your first opportunity
opportunity.body: A deal with a value and a next step.

agent.title: Enable the Sales Agent
agent.body: Qualifies customers and drafts follow-ups under your approval rules.

pipeline.title: Pipeline board
pipeline.body: Every deal by stage, with values you entered.

followups.title: Follow-up center
followups.body: Who to contact today and why.

forecast.title: Revenue forecast
forecast.body: Pipeline and weighted value — from real deals only.

brief.title: Today
brief.stalled: {count, plural, one {deal} other {deals}} didn't move this week

funnel.title: Sales funnel
funnel.description: A current snapshot of all active opportunities — not historical conversion tracking.
funnel.empty: The sales funnel will appear here once your CRM has enough data.
funnel.note: Counts by current stage. Not a conversion rate.

hot.title: Hot customers
hot.empty: The next opportunity starts with a conversation
hot.emptyBody: Customers with high interest will appear here so you know who to start with.

forecast.title: Revenue forecast
forecast.description: Figures start when opportunities have values and stages. The weighted forecast is an estimate by stage — not confirmed revenue.
forecast.headline: Know the value of the opportunities you're working on
forecast.weightedNote: Estimate by stage probability — not confirmed revenue.
forecast.otherCurrencies: Deals in {list} aren't included in the {currency} totals.
forecast.disclaimer: Only deals with a recorded value are counted. Probabilities come from your pipeline stage settings.

insights.title: Sales Agent insights
insights.emptyBody: Demand patterns and stalled deals appear once there is enough data.

stale_open.finding: {count, plural, one {# opportunity has} other {# opportunities have}} had no contact for {days}+ days.
stale_open.why: Customers you don't follow up with go cold.

overdue_followups.finding: {count, plural, one {# customer has} other {# customers have}} overdue follow-ups.

hot_without_step.finding: {count, plural, one {# hot customer has} other {# hot customers have}} no next step.
hot_without_step.why: High interest, but nothing is planned.

top_source.finding: Most qualified customers this month came from {source} ({count} of {total}).
top_source.why: Based on qualified customers created in the last 30 days.

high_value_slower.finding: Quotes above {threshold} stay longer in the Proposal stage ({highDays} vs {lowDays} days).
high_value_slower.why: Compared across current deals in Proposal with a value.

activity.title: Recent activity
activity.empty: A clear record of every step
activity.emptyBody: Added customers, stage changes and follow-ups appear here in time order.

log.title: Opportunity log
log.empty: No stage or value changes yet.

due.title: Due follow-ups
due.suggest: {count, plural, one {# follow-up is} other {# follow-ups are}} due
due.flow: NOVA drafts the messages only → you review → approve → send. Your approval rules apply.

profile.noAttribution: No attribution recorded for this customer.
